# Subgroup generated by a subset of a group

Let $G$ be a group and let $S \subseteq G$. The *subgroup generated by $S$*, written $\langle S \rangle$, is the intersection of all subgroups of $G$ that contain $S$. It is the smallest subgroup of $G$ containing $S$.

## Sources

- David S. Dummit and Richard M. Foote, Abstract Algebra, 3rd ed., John Wiley & Sons, 2004.
